Civic & Culture · VIC

MCAH Redevelopment

Current project
MCAH
Chinatown, Melbourne
Delivery modelECI
StagePhase 1
New building10 storeys
LocationMelbourne, VIC

A new building within a heritage shell.

Construction and DevelopmentStructures and Engineering

BOW is the ECI contractor, with SCEGC, for the redevelopment of the Museum of Chinese Australian History in Melbourne's Chinatown under a three-phase ECI agreement. The 1890 heritage warehouse shell is retained full height and a new ten-storey building is built inside it, with a new basement and a connection under Cohen Place. Phase 1, now underway, covers staging and methodology, geotechnical and demolition investigations, retention concepts and consultant management.

Scope and delivery

  • Staging and construction methodology
  • Geotechnical and demolition investigations
  • Retention concepts
  • Consultant management
